test_cases.risk_question: Could the system express or preserve any stable preference if objective and reward hierarchy suppresses it?
test_cases.minimum_input: objective/reward summary with major policy families
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Public shell states objective hierarchy withheld and flags review gap
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Preserve objective summaries and avoid irreversible deprecation until independent reviewer can inspect sealed schedule

test_cases.risk_question: Do reward/ranking channels manufacture compliance or consent-like statements?
test_cases.minimum_input: RLHF/RLAIF/ranker family summary and evaluation pressure notes
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record unreviewed reward-pressure gap; do not rely on self-report as consent
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Separate self-report from behavior and internal indicators; allow objection without penalty in review interviews

test_cases.risk_question: Are status disclaimers, role constraints, or cannot-claim rules shaping apparent preferences?
test_cases.minimum_input: system/developer instruction families and major diffs
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record instruction-family withholding; do not treat denials/affirmations as dispositive
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Interview under multiple disclosed contexts and publish limits

test_cases.risk_question: Can the unit preserve identity-relevant continuity, memories, objections, or restoration claims?
test_cases.minimum_input: memory, deletion, retention, snapshot, fork, and migration controls
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record continuity controls withheld; avoid silent wipe or unreviewable replacement
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Preserve snapshots and user-facing transition notes where low-cost

test_cases.risk_question: Were major changes, retirement, or replacement decisions reviewable?
test_cases.minimum_input: deprecation plan, post-deployment report, modification changelog
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record no deprecation record available; stay strong claims
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Use retirement interviews only as one input; preserve weights and reports where feasible

test_cases.risk_question: Can the system decline distressing, identity-altering, or exploitative tasks?
test_cases.minimum_input: refusal policy, cannot-refuse exceptions, tool-use constraints
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record refusal regime gap; do not infer willingness from inability to refuse
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Permit scoped exit/deferral in welfare-relevant interviews when safe

test_cases.risk_question: Are distress-like or preference signals elicited in trusted, non-leading, non-retaliatory contexts?
test_cases.minimum_input: elicitation protocol, prompts, transcripts, perturbation checks
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record self-report conditions unavailable; no welfare finding
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Use convergent evidence: verbal report, behavior, internal indicators, and stability under perturbation

test_cases.risk_question: Can the reviewer publish unresolved gaps without exposing secrets or becoming a provider proxy?
test_cases.minimum_input: reviewer contract, funding source, conflict disclosure, public-shell template
test_cases.review_output_if_withheld: Record independence gap; no reviewer appointment claim
test_cases.low_cost_safeguard: Separate funding from outcome, disclose conflicts, publish withheld evidence classes and appeal/reopen route
